sys_script.description: Display rule on x_casemgmt_case (QA Issue 17, field-value half): publishes the STORED status of the row being displayed onto g_scratchpad.x_casemgmt_stored_status so the onLoad client script ../client_scripts/x_casemgmt_case_closed_readonly_enforce.xml can put the form back in step with the database after an aborted submit. The platform re-renders an aborted save with the POSTED values, so pressing Update on an Open case with status set to Draft leaves the form showing Draft - correctly refused with the verbatim "Cases cannot be returned to Draft.", nothing persisted, sys_mod_count unchanged - while the database still holds Open. The stored value is obtained by re-reading the row from the database by its own sys_id with a fresh GlideRecord, the same technique CaseTransitionValidator._storedRecord() uses, and never by reading a status off current: it is not established whether a display rule receives the stored or the posted record on an abort re-render, and this rule is correct either way. Fail-safe: the empty string is published first and remains published on every abnormal path (no g_scratchpad, a new record with no sys_id, a row that cannot be re-read because it was deleted or the read ACLs deny it, or any exception), and the client treats the empty string as "nothing to correct". Read-only by construction - when=display with all four action_* flags false - so enforcement stays entirely in the before-update rules and the shared Script Include. Writes no record, changes no field and calls no message API, because the blocking banner from the aborted save must survive per AAP Sections 0.5.5 and 0.7.1. Per AAP Sections 0.5.5, 0.7.1 and 0.7.2.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state
